description: NaLaTa(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.47 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.28 Å) and three longer (2.35 Å) La-O bond lengths. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.01 Å) and three longer (2.07 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-42°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.62 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ta and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one P atom.
